svg.text: Foot and upright: 4 mm steel strip 40 wide, bent to an L: foot

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 20 long, upright 44 tall to the shelf.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Shelf: 6 mm plate 60 x 50, welded to the top of the upright,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: reaching forward. Drill it for the lidar's own mounting holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Foot: two 5.5 mm holes; it is screwed M5 into rivet nuts in the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: top of the hoop's front bar, on the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the lidar's scan plane must be 200 mm above the floor, and the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: lidar's front 10 mm behind the safety edge face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: shelf level within 1 degree side to side and front to back.
